verses.text: Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tik yowalil ol he b'eyb'alej ayik ayexxoek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham eyikej.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a lum lum chi', ch'ok sdiosal heb' b'aj syal sb'a. Ayik toxo ix eyikejel lum sluum heb' chi', yowalil tze satel juntzanh yik lesal b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal, wach'chom t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Tze mak'poj juntzanh yaltar heb', k'een k'een yet' te te' b'ob'il sdiosalok heb' skuchan Asera, haton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb'. Tze nhusantz'aok, tze mak'anpoj sdiosal heb' chi', yik wach' manhxa b'ak'uinh snachajkot t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Manh ichok tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', manh ichokta tz'aj eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Ha t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová t'a skal eyinhtilal to yik yaji, hata' ol b'at eyak'em he b'a t'ay.

Ol eyak'an he silab' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová. Ol eyak'anpax he diezmo, he kolwal yet' tas ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani yet' eyofrenda to tz'el wal t'a he k'ol eyak'ani. Hanheja' ol eyak'anpax nok' sb'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel.
Hata' ol ex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol he pat. Icha chi' ol aj he waan tas tzeyik' t'a he munlajel a to syal swach'k'olal Jehová ol yak' t'ayex.
Hata' manh ol he k'ulej icha tas sko k'ulej tiknaik, yujto ha t'a tik yalnhej tas snib'ej junjun anima, a sk'ulej.
Wal yel manto ex k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová t'ayex, hata' manhxalaj tas ol he na'a.

Wanxo sk'och sk'ual yik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tzex k'ochkan t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová eyikej. Ayik toxo ix ex kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, manhxa xiwk'olal t'ayex ta'.

Haxo jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och yikok, hata' ol eyak' masanil tas ix wal t'ayex to ol he k'ulej. Hata' ol eyak' nok' silab' stz'ai yet' juntzanh silab' yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová chi', he diezmo, he kolwal yet' eyofrenda sik'b'ilel eyuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani.
Tzex te tzalaj t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' eyuninal, heb' he chekab' yet' heb' levita ol kajnaj t'a he kal. Yujto a heb' levita chi' malaj smakb'en heb' ol scha heyet'ok t'a lum lum chi'.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he komon nhusejtz'a nok' he silab' t'a yalnhej tas lugaril he gana.
Anhej t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová t'a skal he chonhab' smasanil, hata' tzeyik'b'at he silab' yik tze nhusantz'aok yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik tze naank'e he chi'an nok' chib'ej, syal he milancham junok nok' eyiko' tze chi'an b'aj ayex ek' chi', hato syal tas syak' Jehová t'ayex. Wach'chom ayex wach' eyaji, icha yalan ley, mato maay, syal he chi'ani, ichok tz'aj he chi'an junok nok' ch'ukul ma junok nok' k'ultakil chej.
Anhej wal schiq'uil nok' b'ian, manh jab'ok syal he chi'ani, ma eyuk'ani, anhej to tze tob'kanem t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.

Max yal he wa''an sdiezmoal he trigo t'a yol he chonhab', ma sdiezmoal he wino, eyaceite, ma he chi'an nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel, ma eyofrenda tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma he kolwal, ma eyofrenda tz'och b'akhan t'a yichanh Jehová.

Anhej t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal, hata' ol he chi' juntzanh silab' chi', ajun heb' eyal eyuninal heyet'ok yet' heb' he chekab' yet' heb' levita ayek' t'a he kal. Hata' tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tas syak' t'a he munlajel chi'.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a jun lu'um chi', mokab' b'at heb' levita satk'olal eyuuj.
Ha wal yik ol lewanb'ok he lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a jantak yak'nak sti' yak'ani, tato syal he k'ol ol he chi nok' chib'ej, ol yal he chi'an nok' t'a yalnhej tas k'ual.

Tato najat kajan ex t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi', syal he milancham nok' he wakax yet' nok' he kalnel syak' Jehová chi' t'ayex b'aj kajan ex chi', tze chi'an nok' icha syal jantak snib'ej he k'ool, icha ix aj walan t'ayex.
Ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an yalnhej tas makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej, icha chi' tz'ajpax he chi'ani, tato wach' heyaj icha yalan ley, mato maay, syalnhej he chi'an nok'.
Palta max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej max el-laj schiq'uil, yujto ha t'a schiq'uil nok' chi' ay sk'inal. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej chi' yet' sk'inal.
Anhej to tze tob'kanel schiq'uil nok' chi' t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.
Manh he chi'a, manh eyuk'ej schiq'uil nok' nok' chi' yik wach'nhej ol ex ajelk'och yet' eyinhtilal yuj he k'anab'ajan Jehová.
Ha pax masanil tas to yikxo Dios yaj eyuuj jun yet' tastak toxo ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, yowalil tzeyik'b'at t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová.

Ha t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová ko Diosal, hata' tzeyak' nok' he silab' to stz'a smasanil schib'ejal yet' schiq'uil nok'. Haxo pax junxo makan nok' he silab' jun, syal he chi'an schib'ejal nok', anhej wal schiq'uil nok' stob'chajkanoch t'a yich altar t'a yichanh Jehová.

Scham eyab'ani yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swal tik, yik wach' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'at yet' heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, yujto tze k'anab'ajej tas scha sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal, tojol exnhej t'a yol sat.
Ayik ol satjokel masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová ko Diosal, a exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'a sat slum heb' chi'.

Scham wal heyilani, manh ex b'at tzak'an t'a sb'eyb'al heb' icha tz'aj yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal. Manh he k'anb'ej tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', yik wach' manh ichokta tzeyutejpax he b'a.

Manh ichok syutej sb'a heb' chi', manh ichok chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej heb' chi' chakb'ilel yuj. Ha juntzanh chi' haton sb'eyb'alej heb' anima chi' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ay pax b'aj snhustz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a sdiosal chi'.
k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Manh eyik'el jab'ok, manh eyak'paxoch stz'akub' juntzanh cheknab'il tik.
